The '''65th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary film|documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2012, were presented on February 2, 2013, at the [[Hollywood and Highland Center]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/dga-awards-ben-affleck-named-417646 |title=DGA Awards: Ben Affleck Named Best Director for 'Argo' |last1=Couch |first1=Aaron |last2=Kilday |first2=Gregg |date=February 2, 2013 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |access-date=February 7, 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2013/000213-DGA-Awards-Winners.aspx|title=Ben Affleck Wins DGA Feature Film Award For 'Argo'|publisher=[[Directors Guild of America]]|date=February 2, 2013 |access-date=January 7, 2014}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Kelsey Grammer]] for the second time.<ref>{{cite web|title=Kelsey Grammer to Host 65th Annual DGA Awards|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2012/121218-Kelsey-Grammer-to-Host-65th-Annual-DGA-Awards.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=December 18, 2012}}</ref> The nominees for the feature film category were announced on January 8, 2013,<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Award Nominations Announced|url=https://deadline.com/2013/01/directors-guild-award-nominations-2013-announced-list-399025/|website=Deadline Hollywood|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 8, 2013}}</ref> the nominations for the television and commercial categories were announced on January 9, 2013,<ref>{{cite news|last1=Ford|first1=Rebecca|title=DGA Awards TV Nominations Announced|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/dga-awards-tv-nominations-announced-410237|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 9, 2013}}</ref> and the nominees for documentary directing were announced on January 14, 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Awards Unveils Documentary Nominees|url=https://deadline.com/2013/01/dga-awards-2013-documentary-nominees-list-403979/|website=Deadline Hollywood|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 14, 2013}}</ref>
